technique_name: Write a persuasive paragraph to convince people to avoid single-use plastics.
description: Single-use plastics can have devastating effects on our environment. They are not biodegradable and take hundreds of years to break down. This means they are around for a long time, acting as pollutants and filling up landfills. Single-use plastics also contribute to global warming and can have a serious effect on our oceans and the animals that live in them.
